project_title: Salesforce Commercial Banking - Account & Relationship Creation Flow (SLDS 2)
archetype: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST / THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Salesforce SLDS 2 Commercial Banking)

theme_strategy.description: Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS 2) precision aesthetic with slate blue accents, crisp borders, compact density, and high visual clarity for enterprise relationship managers.

layout_and_spacing.table_density: compact SLDS 2 datatable with sticky header, row hover effects, and crisp cell borders

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #D8DCE6 with subtle dark mode adjustments
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800
visual_enhancers.slds_path_component: Multi-step Salesforce Progress Path header (1. Select Level -> 2. Search & Validate -> 3. Match Results -> 4. Account Action)

key_functionalities_and_ux_flow.step_1_level_selection: Card selection for L1 Primary Relationship (Holdings / Ultimate Parent) and L2 Intermediate Relationship (Sub-holding / Regional Operating Entity). Displays read-only descriptions for L3 Legal Entity & L4 Financial Account.
key_functionalities_and_ux_flow.step_2_search_validation: 5 filter controls: Relationship/Account Name (text), Relationship ID (text), Country/Region (picklist), Industry (picklist), Status (picklist). Includes quick resets & mock data preset triggers.
key_functionalities_and_ux_flow.step_3_results_datatable: Client-side DataTables.net interactive table showing seeded rich commercial banking records. Dynamic columns adapted per level (e.g. Credit Rating, Ultimate Parent, Tax ID, Segment). Features in-browser filter/search, quick preview drawer icon, and launch CTA.
key_functionalities_and_ux_flow.step_4a_launch_readonly: Read-only detailed drawer / modal displaying hierarchy tree, credit limits, AML/KYC status, key contacts, and sub-entities.
key_functionalities_and_ux_flow.step_4b_dynamic_create_form: Full SLDS 2 validated creation form for L1 & L2 with sections for General Info, Financial/Regulatory Details, Address & Region, and Relationship Assignment. Form validation, error indicators, and instant mock submission to local state table.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (SLDS brand buttons, pill-shaped badges, sharp primary actions) with hover states.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use Lucide icons or SLDS svg icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, slide-over preview drawers.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.

All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='step-level-l1-card', data-testid='search-account-name-input', data-testid='submit-create-account-button').
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, dropdowns, or drawer surfaces.
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a rich, interactive, production-ready React web app in /app/frontend/src/App.js representing the Salesforce Commercial Banking CRM Screen Flow.
Implement SLDS 2 layout styling: Header with Salesforce Global Header bar, Navigation tabs, Salesforce Lightning Path component at top of flow.
Support all 4 levels in hierarchy: L1 (Primary Relationship), L2 (Intermediate Relationship), L3 (Legal Entity), L4 (Financial Account).
Integrate DataTables/shadcn table with client-side sorting, column filtering, row preview side-drawer, and launch action.
Implement rich seed data with 15+ realistic enterprise banking records (e.g., Apex Global Corp, Horizon Energy Holdings, Pacific Retail Logistics).
Provide a sleek Dark/Light theme toggle in top utility bar.
Ensure full client-side state preservation and reactivity so creating an L1/L2 account dynamically inserts it into the datatable.
